verdict.rationale: Deel's docs describe general global payroll processing and API/MCP tools for contracts, time-off, and cost comparisons, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions off-cycle payroll runs, bonus payments, correction runs, or termination-triggered payroll outside the regular schedule.
